headline: Hamilton comes out on top after 5 lead changes in Barcelona
standfirst: Lewis Hamilton won the Barcelona Grand Prix for Ferrari, finishing 19.561s ahead of George Russell, with Lando Norris completing the podium after 66 laps of Catalunya.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: George Russell lined up first on the grid. Russell converted that into the lead at the end of lap one. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Sainz, up 3 places to 13th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 5 times. Laps led: Russell (32), Hamilton (29), Antonelli (4) and Leclerc (1). Hamilton took the lead for good on lap 38. The race ran green from start to finish.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Hamilton made 3 stops, running soft → hard → medium → hard tyres. The field made 47 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.1s for Albon on lap 29.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Pierre Gasly made up the most ground, climbing 7 places from 14th to 7th. Timing recorded 296 on-track position changes, 23 of them by Bearman.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Leclerc (lap 63), Antonelli (lap 62), Bearman (lap 61), Alonso (lap 38), Stroll (lap 6), Hulkenberg (lap 30) and Bottas (lap 16) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 48°C to 52°C, with air at 30–31°C. Lewis Hamilton set the fastest lap, a 1:20.122 on lap 44.
